Description: This is a sample to demonstrate Libertas Rust SDK.

List.Name: libertas_sprinkler
List.Description:
The user configures the information about each zone.
It automatically calculate the optimal watering schedule for each zone based on onfomration such as
watering history, weather forecast, etc.
During runtime, the user can maintain a list of "hold-off" periods on each zone when watering shall be prevented.
The hold-off period list will affect the watring schedule acting as a constraint.

List.Name: Notification list
List.Description: A list of users and groups that receive notifications when hold-off periods are updated.

List.Name: Zone information
List.Description: Information about the sprinkler zone's next watering schedule and hold-off period list. A hold-off ensures the zone won't be watered during the period.

List.Name: Next watering schedule
List.Description: The next scheduled watering time and duration. This schedule is dynamically calculated and may change later. The calculation must avoid the hold-off periods.

List.Name: Hold off periods
List.Description: The list of sprinkler's hold-off period that the dynamic calculation of watering schedule must avoid. A hold-off ensures a sprinkler zone (area) won't be watered during the period.

List.Name: Hold off period
List.Description: A start time and duration of a watering hold-off.

List.Name: Update hold off periods
List.Description: A request to update the entire list of "hold off" periods of the sprinkler zone. The system ensures the zone won't be watered during each hold off period.
